review_type: narrow read-only re-review; no run, import, clinical data read or test execution

resolved_findings.evidence: Per-slot outer try/except/finally always records evaluated or failed closure after reservation. GLS exceptions are separately preserved, and remaining fixed slots continue. No native retry is introduced.

Exact ordered six arm/seed/run IDs, attempt SHA256 bindings and release hash checked before evaluation. Each reservation identity/release is checked; each successful execution receipt is verified and matched to recorded SHA, candidate arm and seed.
Unreserved native/GLS/stdout/stderr artifacts are rejected. New native result input SHA must match table; nonzero process returning a computed JSON is marked process_failed_with_partial_result.

retained_invariants: Exactly native/agent x seeds6101/6102/6103, six exclusive generation attempts.
No outcome-guided reauthoring, refit, optimizer retry or seed replacement in controller.
All generation closure checks precede all native evaluation.
Native runtime wrapper enforces300seconds and host325seconds; GLS has separate120second cap.
Interrupted reservation is an explicit stop requiring safe manual closure, never an automatic rerun.
Generator runtime isolation remains the existing harness; no fallback execution.

nonblocking_note.detail: GLS process returncode is retained separately from JSON status. Downstream acceptance must require returncode==0 and status==pass; optionally mark a nonzero/JSON-pass combination as process_failed_with_partial_result in the controller. The current independent checker normally returns zero only for pass.

release_boundary: A code-review pass is not permission to bypass final source/candidate/evaluator/runtime byte commitments. Coordinator release must bind those reviewed files before formal execution.
